text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With summer camp coming up, Super Creek gushes about wanting to spoil me rotten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also wants to find a way to overcome her bad health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After surmising what the cause of her condition might be, I make it my goal to have her change her mindset.
